name: Streaming Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Daos As New Entrepreneurial Firms 73Efd9Cbd2
text: Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) as New Entrepreneurial Firms argues that DAOs can reduce traditional agency costs and improve transparency while creating new coordination, participation, and systemic risks. The proposition supports Kaal's account of DAOs as a challenge to agency-based organization, but it also reinforces his warning that governance without effective mechanisms can become slow and inefficient. The abstract synthesizes studies and theory; it does not establish causal effects.
